psychological_meaning: Boston Blue evokes feelings of calmness, trustworthiness, and stability. It is often associated with intelligence, efficiency, and reflection. This color promotes a sense of security and order, while also encouraging creativity and innovation. Its serene nature can help to reduce stress and create a peaceful environment.
